annotations.title: Brazilian Company Board and Executive Pay

description: Get the board of directors, executive officers and fiscal council of a company listed on B3, and what each body is paid, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:VALE3), as the company's newest reference form states them. Each body lists a person once, with the highest office they hold there (CEO, CFO, chair, independent member and so on), whether a board seat is independent, the date their first term began and whether the controlling shareholder nominated them. Pay is per body and fiscal year in reais, never per person: average member count, salary and benefits, bonus and profit sharing, share-based, post-employment, termination, other and total, with the highest, average and lowest member's pay, for the past fiscal years and the budget for the year the form covers. For a US listing's executive pay use GetExecutiveCompensation.

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:VALE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.
